info.about: Def Jam: Fight for NY is a 3D fighting video game developed by AKI Corporation and EA Canada and published by EA Games. It was released for the GameCube, PlayStation 2, and Xbox on September 21, 2004.
info.trivia: A wrestling game whose roster is licensed rappers, from Method Man to Snoop Dogg.
info.why: Dozens of licensed artists and tracks make a re-release practically impossible, and a cult following keeps demand high.
